text: The UK government sanctioned the Akhmat Kadyrov Foundation in September 2025 for running 're-education' programmes for Ukrainian children and teenagers, subjecting them to militaristic training, as part of Russia's policy of forcibly deporting and indoctrinating Ukrainian children. Its president is Aymani Kadyrova, the mother of Chechen head Ramzan Kadyrov.
short: UK: the Akhmat Kadyrov Foundation runs 're-education' programmes for deported Ukrainian children
